exposure: Skin and mucous membrane colonization with Staphylococcus aureus
Skin and mucous membrane colonization with methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus
cohort: 127 patients who underwent elective Caesarean Section surgeries
finding: Participants with positive skin and mucous membrane colonisation were found to have SSI incidence 2.43 times more than the non-colonised participants.
